description: Importers for RecursiveAI.OnePhysics: URDF and MJCF robots become articulation definitions, glTF physics extensions become 3D scenes, Tiled and LDtk maps become 2D tile grids and bodies. Hostile input is rejected with typed errors; the same bytes give the same definitions on every platform.

Deterministic 2D and 3D physics for .NET with identical results on every platform: rigid bodies, joints, characters, vehicles, ragdolls, ropes, cloth and soft bodies, fluids, fracture, articulations, and rollback tooling (byte-exact snapshots, world hashes, replays).

Authoring-time geometry for RecursiveAI.OnePhysics: 3D convex decomposition, hull simplification, mesh cleaning and mass properties, tetrahedralization and quality triangulation for soft bodies, ragdoll fitting from a skeleton, 2D polygon decomposition and sprite outlines.
